board_v5_rates.basis: Periodic V5 FPGA second ticks and counters; independently establish corrected/raw mode and output quality

dynamic_log_analysis.timing_proxy_warning: Source-input/pose-receive proxy uses POS1 receive time as an uncalibrated board-to-host clock anchor. It includes unknown UART/USB/OS delay; IMU measurement latency is unknown. Signed proxy is not exposure alignment or end-to-end error.
dynamic_log_analysis.boundaries: Host times are observations. LAT1 starts at FPGA camera valid pixel, excludes exposure, sensor, capture card, USB display and panel. map_cycles includes controller work/waits, not necessarily pure coordinate computation.
dynamic_log_analysis.window_filter: Transaction metrics include only requests with write_started recorded inside this window.

offline_pds.kind: offline PDS compile result; not a live measurement

host_framing_window.scope: Host parser counter changes across button-recording window; raw JSONL contains CRC-valid packets only.

notes: No new hardware access. Source is the existing single-owner session log.
Throughput may span pose configuration versions within a mode; latency distributions are separated by config version.
Mode is host-observed context, not an exact same-frame assertion. Actual LAT route bits and config version are separate grouping keys.
Unknown/absent metrics remain null. This report is not automatic contest acceptance.
Gamma status is asynchronous, not exact per-frame Gamma attribution.
Geometric error, MTF and physical viewing latency are not measured by this telemetry.
